depends_on: Specht module S^(k+1,k-1) irreducible; sl2 decomposition of the Boolean lattice
notes: T_{n,2,2} = S/(x_1^2..x_n^2)^2 has the WLP for every n (char 0). BFL 2018 proved odd n; for n = 2k only x l: R_{k+1} -> R_{k+2} was open. Its kernel corresponds to beta in ker U = S^(k+1,k-1) with every link in Im U^2; the equivariant map to the quotients is nonzero (pairing 2^k with w = U v' in ker D^2), hence injective by Schur. Rank checks over GF(32749): WLP for n = 3..9, critical degree for n = 10. Outside Lean: the whole argument (representation theory of S_n not available in Mathlib in usable form) and the rank computations (Python).
